description: This is a Go source file implementing a translator component named PiTranslator, which interfaces with an external docsPiClient to perform language translation with retry and error handling logic. The code defines functions for translation, raw translation, retry policies, placeholder masking/unmasking, and context handling.

classes.name: PiTranslator
classes.description: A struct representing a translator that communicates with a docsPiClient to perform translation operations, including retries and placeholder masking.

methods.name: NewPiTranslator
methods.description: Constructs a new PiTranslator instance with specified source and target languages and other configuration.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Performs translation of a given text with masked placeholders, with context support.

methods.name: TranslateRaw
methods.description: Performs raw translation of a given text without masking.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Internal method to execute translation functions with prefix/suffix handling and retries.

methods.name: translateWithRetry
methods.description: Executes a translation run with retry logic based on error type.

methods.name: translateMasked
methods.description: Performs masked translation with placeholder management.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closing the client connection.

methods.name: runPrompt
methods.description: Executes a prompt run via the promptRunner interface, with context timeout handling.
